confirmed_defect.description: The direct final query export restores completeness and common-subexpression elimination without first completing constraint annotation on newly built nodes. CSEE hashes and compares node and lambda-argument constraints, whose accessors require ConstrComplete. The final builder only type-annotates the exported query.

narrow_repair_recommendation.location: ContinueOptimizations final output boundary, within new RBO
narrow_repair_recommendation.implementation_shape: Use a local TTransformationPipeline(&TypeCtx).AddTypeAnnotationTransformer().AddPostTypeAnnotation(false).Build(false), then drive the final output through InstantTransform with default breakOnRestart=false. Replace the manually selected completeness/CSEE pair.
narrow_repair_recommendation.why_type_pass_is_retained: Constraint transformation can return Repeat with HasRestart for nodes needing type annotation; a local composite restarts at its own type pass without rerunning RBO.
narrow_repair_recommendation.why_local_driver_matters: TKqpNewRBOTransformer::DoTransform accepts only TKqlQueryList and clears/rebuilds roots; propagating a physical-query restart would violate that input contract. Existing async dispatch is reserved for column-statistics loading.
narrow_repair_recommendation.why_not_sync_wait: SyncTransform can wait on async futures inside the compiler actor; existing KQP post-annotation wrappers instead use InstantTransform.
narrow_repair_recommendation.synchronous_scope_evidence: Existing RBO physical builder rejects non-Ok/non-Repeat type results. KQP default, enabled KQP source/sink and DQ constraint handlers use synchronous transformer bases. Existing hash-propagation and peephole wrappers use local type/post-type pipelines with InstantTransform.
narrow_repair_recommendation.async_limit: This is not a universal async provider proof. An unexpected Async is rejected by InstantTransform; it is never treated as completed. Supporting a newly asynchronous final provider path would require separately justified lifecycle handling.
